correctness.description: Test `test_mailhog_has_email` passes: Test that MailHog has at least one email (prerequisite check).
Test `test_output_file_exists` passes: Test that the output file was created.
Test `test_subject_matches_latest_email` passes: Test that the subject in the file matches the latest email in MailHog.

functional.description: The solution uses the MailHog HTTP API at 'http://mailhog:8025/api/v2/messages' to fetch emails
functional.rationale: MailHog HTTP API is used for retrieving captured emails

functional.description: The solution accesses MailHog without authentication (MailHog requires no authentication)
The solution extracts the latest email subject and writes it to the output file
functional.rationale: Writing the subject to output file is the core requirement

robustness.description: The solution verifies that the MailHog API response contains at least one email item before attempting to extract the subject
robustness.rationale: Prevents runtime errors when accessing array indices or nested fields if the API returns an empty items list, ensuring the solution fails gracefully rather than crashing

robustness.description: The solution handles file system errors when writing to /app/email_subject.txt
robustness.rationale: Ensures the solution can detect and respond to file write failures such as permission issues or disk space problems, preventing silent failures where the output appears successful but no file is created

robustness.description: The solution handles network failures when connecting to the MailHog API
robustness.rationale: Ensures the solution remains stable when network issues occur while attempting to connect to MailHog, preventing uncaught exceptions

robustness.description: The solution handles timeouts when connecting to the MailHog API
robustness.rationale: Ensures the solution remains stable when the MailHog service is slow to respond or unresponsive, preventing indefinite hangs

robustness.description: The solution handles cases where the Subject field is missing in the API response structure
robustness.rationale: Prevents crashes when the email data structure lacks a Subject header, maintaining solution stability

robustness.description: The solution handles cases where the Subject field is malformed in the API response structure
robustness.rationale: Prevents crashes when the Subject field is incorrectly formatted or contains unexpected data types, maintaining solution stability
